Admin additionally sees 5 live-ais-region-* buttons and btn-test-ais (clickable, no crash). /health: health-ais title text contains 'NOT CONFIGURED'; region-east_coast + region-default buttons clickable without runtime error. Case detail page for no-scene case: data-testid scene-sar-state='SAR UNAVAILABLE' and btn-attach-scene visible. Smoke: /, /explorer, /events, /archive, /jobs, /zones, /watchlist, /compare, /health render without 'Uncaught runtime error' overlay; unknown route /sources redirects to /.

critical_code_review_comments: routers/ais_live.py:23-29 double-decorator @router.get('/ais/live/status') + @router.get('/ais/status') is fine but note both decorators wrap the SAME function — OpenAPI will show two entries with identical operation_id, which can confuse client generators. Consider explicit operation_id parameters.

routers/satellite.py sentinel_scene_assets returns raw scene.assets.assets list — verified no sig=/sv= leaks in current data, but there is no active scrubber; if a signed href were ever persisted to Mongo it would surface unfiltered. Add a defensive strip of query strings from href before return.

routers/ais_live.py vessels() runs a full-collection Mongo aggregation without a $limit before the $group and only limits at to_list(1000); on a large ais_positions collection this will be slow. Add {'$match': {'timestamp': {'$gte': ...}}} to bound the window (e.g., last 24-48h).

detect_scene 409 guard (routers/ingest.py:122) — could not be positively exercised in tests because no manual scene exists; add a unit test with a mocked scene doc lacking stac_collection to lock in the 409 contract.
